summary: Backend testing complete for Cafe Bill Generator. 23/23 pytest cases passed covering auth (login/me/logout, cookies, bearer fallback, 401s), menu CRUD + seeded 12 items, settings GET/PUT + auth guard, bills (create with totals math, list newest-first, get by id, empty items validation), and stats summary.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False. Works in current setup because frontend is reverse-proxied same-origin via Kubernetes ingress, but if a true cross-origin browser call were made with withCredentials=true, cookies would not be sent. Consider setting explicit origins + allow_credentials=True for robustness.
secure=False on access_token/refresh_token. Acceptable for preview/dev, but should be True in production behind HTTPS. samesite='lax' is fine.
Intentionally unauthenticated per spec — fine, but documented in spec.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~530 lines and still manageable; consider splitting into routers/ (auth, menu, bills, settings) when it grows past ~700 lines.
stats/summary iterates the bills collection in Python; for scale, use a single MongoDB aggregation ($facet with today_filter + grand totals).
Bill validation: tax_percent/service_percent/discount_amount have no lower-bound guard (negative values would be accepted). Consider Pydantic Field(ge=0).
set_auth_cookies uses secure=False — flag for production hardening.
_get_settings auto-creates a default doc on every GET if missing; OK but slightly chatty. Already seeded on startup.
test_credentials: admin@cafe.com / admin123 (seeded on startup, confirmed working)
seed_data_creation: Tests created TEST_-prefixed bills (Coffee/Muffin/Tea) and one TEST_Mocha menu item that was deleted in CRUD flow. Settings were temporarily changed and restored.
